content.comment_body: Hello, I encounter the error 'Blocks without connection to an output: B001 [Message texts]' when uploading a program to my [product_name] device, which includes the display module. How can I resolve this issue?

Each block must be connected (this does not apply in simulation mode on your PC). You can connect blocks using: a) Outputs (these can also be outputs not physically present on your [product_name] device); b) Markers or flags (use these in your program for further connections); c) Open connectors (these are not connected to any destination). While programming on your PC, press F2 to see blocks lacking connections. Connect these, then you can transfer the program to your [product_name] device. Best of luck.
Thank you, I'll give that a try.

Hello, when downloading the program to my [product_name] device, I encounter these errors: 'Blocks without connection to an output: B019 [Latching Relay], B024 [Latching Relay]. Download from PC to [product_name] failed.' To resolve such issues, I usually manually inspect blocks/contacts to find those not connected. Is there a way for the software to cycle through the errors or guide step-by-step to locate the exact problematic rung or block?

Hi, The block numbers B019 and B024 identified in the error help you locate the issue. Use the shortcut CTRL + G to activate the 'go to block' command. Enter the block number, and it will take you directly to that block. Regards.

Hello, 1. Try downloading your program without connecting the [product_name] device. 2. Press F4 or go to View > Info Window. There you'll see detailed error information. Following [user_name]'s suggestion, you can navigate directly to the faulty block. Regards,
Hi, Good suggestion on using point 2! You could also use the F2 button to compile your program—no need to download. The F2 compile also provides additional statistics you may not need. Regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users commonly face an error indicating blocks not connected to outputs when working with [product_name] devices. This error interrupts the upload or download process, requiring manual inspection to connect unlinked blocks. While block numbers are provided, users find the process for error identification and navigation in the software could be more intuitive and prefer a more guided or interactive troubleshooting workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to clearly highlight blocks causing errors and offer efficient, guided methods for resolution. They would like a step-by-step or interactive approach for error correction within the programming environment.
